howToApply: Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) by navigating to the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registration, candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC inviting them to fill up a detailed application and make payment for the Online Examination for ‘LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program’.
Visit https://beep.bfsissc.com to submit additional information and make the examination fee payment before 01-Nov-2026.
Note your Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence.
All eligible applicants who have paid the examination fee will receive an online examination link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the examination date.
Appear for the online remote proctored examination on 07-Nov-2026 from home using a camera-enabled device with good internet connectivity.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Document Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices on 15-Nov-2026.
Final selected candidates will receive engagement letters from LIC HFL tentatively in the 3rd week of November.

howToApply: Before applying, candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position.
Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website: http://www.rites.com.

While submitting the online application, the system would generate a ‘Registration No.’ on top of the online form filled up by the candidate. Note down this Registration No. and quote it for all further communication with RITES Ltd.
Carefully and correctly fill the details of ‘Identity Proof’ while filling up the required details.
After filling up the required details, submit the application. Keep a copy of the Application Form submitted and carry the same at the time of selection.

Print, sign, and furnish a copy of the online APPLICATION FORM containing the registration number at the time of document verification/interview along with self-attested photocopies and originals of: Passport size Photograph, High School certificate (Date of Birth proof), Academic & Professional qualification certificates, Experience certificates, Proof of Identity & Address, PAN Card, and any other supporting documents.
Scanned copies of all above-mentioned documents need to be uploaded on RITES website for successful submission of applications.
Hard copies of documents are NOT to be sent to the office through post/courier.
Applications once submitted cannot be altered. A valid e-mail ID is essential for submission of the online application.
Candidates can apply for any number of vacancies.
For queries, send email to yp.rites@rites.com with VC No., Registration/Roll No., Full Name, and valid email address.

dates.event: Opening Date for Submission of Online Applications

howToApply: Visit the official website www.npcilcareers.co.in and click on ‘Apply => Online Registration’.
Step 1 – Registration: Fill in basic information such as Name, Date of Birth, Category, Email, and Mobile Number. An activation link will be sent to your registered email.
Step 2 – Activation: Click on the activation link received via email to activate your account.

Step 3 – Fill Application: Login using your Login ID and Password. Fill in all details including Educational Qualifications, Marks of CA/CMA, Personal Details, and upload scanned Photograph (JPEG, max 50KB, max 480×640 pixels, min 10KB, min 180×240 pixels) and Signature (JPEG, max 20KB, max 160×560 pixels, min 80×100 pixels).
Step 4 – Submit Application: Review the draft application, make any necessary corrections, and submit. An Application Number will be generated upon successful submission.
Step 5 – Print Application Form: After submission, view and print the Online Application Form.
There is NO application fee for applying for the Internship.
Do NOT send any documents/application to NPCIL by post or in person.
